publication_copy.headline: WHY THE BOARD MOVED
publication_copy.body: McCaffrey’s 52.60 drives Slob on my Dobb. His Majesty's Blood’s Purdy–Hubbard–Smith-Njigba trio supplies 113.86; The LLC’s Burrow–Likely–Washington trio adds 103.66. Dr. Duckhook answers with Gibbs’ 47.40. El Niño reaches 189.08 while Pickens’ 44.50 stays on the bench. These are current contributions; Monday can still change the board.
